opening.argument: The observable function is exchange-spread monitoring: the description presents a free Telegram bot that tracks spreads across exchanges and offers viewers personal arbitrage signals. The displayed Dogecoin/Bitcoin chart and cryptocurrency-pair alerts in a Telegram chat are consistent with that function. Viewers are invited to use the bot and join Telegram communities, but the supplied material does not request payment, private data, or a transfer of funds. Nor does it claim guaranteed profits or assume a deceptive identity. The external Telegram destination is part of how the alerts are delivered; on this record, it does not establish a financial demand or a promised trading outcome.

citations.quote: Free custom Telegram bot made for auto monitoring the spread between 12 exchanges and more than 77 digital assets!
